jobs.title: Research Engineer / Scientist - Reinforcement Learning
jobs.description:
**Own Your Intelligence**
-------------------------

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

**Role Impact**
---------------

Help develop the algorithms and systems used to train Prime Intellect’s open models with reinforcement learning. We’re hiring research engineers and scientists across RL algorithms, scaling research, and training frameworks. Your focus will reflect your strengths; you don’t need to cover all three.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Algorithm research**

* Develop and test RL methods for reasoning, coding, and long-horizon tasks, including changes to training objectives and policy optimization.
* Investigate stability in asynchronous RL, including policy staleness, trainer/sampler mismatch, and numerical differences between training and rollouts.
* Work with data and evaluation researchers to understand how task selection, rewards, and training data affect what the model learns.

**Scaling science**

* Design experiments to understand how RL performance and learning dynamics change with model size, training compute, and task horizon.
* Use controlled ablations and evaluations to distinguish learning gains from reward exploitation, evaluation artifacts, or training bugs.
* Turn experimental findings into training recipes, then test whether the improvements hold across larger models and longer runs.

**RL frameworks**

* Extend prime-rl to support new algorithms, models, and asynchronous training workflows.
* Improve the performance and numerical correctness of research runs across trainers, rollout workers, and environments, working with the infrastructure team.
* Build diagnostics that make unstable runs and performance regressions easier to reproduce, and help distinguish algorithm problems from implementation or runtime issues.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Demonstrated depth in at least one of RL algorithms, empirical research on model training, or distributed ML systems. This could come through research, open-source contributions, or systems you’ve built.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience with PyTorch or a comparable ML framework.
* Ability to design controlled experiments, interpret results, and debug unexpected model or system behavior.
* Experience taking a research idea or systems change through implementation, testing, and evaluation, with a clear account of what worked and what didn’t.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with distributed training frameworks or asynchronous rollout pipelines.
* Experience diagnosing unstable RL runs, including policy-staleness or numerical issues.
* Work on coding agents, verifiable rewards, or long-horizon environments.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Cash Compensation Range of $150-350k, including equity incentives, aligning your success with the growth and impact of Prime Intellect.
* Flexible work arrangements, with the option to work remotely or in-person at our offices in San Francisco.
* Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance for international candidates.
* Quarterly team off-sites, hackathons, conferences and learning opportunities.
* Opportunity to work with a talented, hard-working and mission-driven team, united by a shared passion for leveraging technology to accelerate science and AI.

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
### **Job Summary**

Our Internal Acceleration team’s mandate is to build agents to accelerate the production of frontier tokens.

You’ll work directly with our founders and embed with our hardware team to build new agentic harnesses and operating systems to transform the way hardware is built in an AI native world. You’ll work on harnesses, tool use, context, and memory, execution environments, and evals that let agents conduct long-running engineering work that is useful.

This role is for engineers who thrive on ambiguity, have real product sense, and want to own problems end to end. It’s a whiteboard for future founders. The problems we solve are time-sensitive and business-critical. This role will not be a 9-5, and the ideal candidate is excited about that.

### **You may be a good fit if you**

* Have at least 1-5+ years of experience building and shipping software end to end, ideally at a fast-moving startup
* Have built agents for complex, multi-step tasks that people depend on, beyond calling an API: tool design, long-context management, evals, and failure analysis.
* Are a strong software engineer who has built reliable systems others depend on, such as distributed systems, experiment infrastructure, or developer tooling.
* Use coding agents heavily, read their transcripts closely, and change the system when an agent is confidently wrong.
* Have high agency in unfamiliar domains. You find the real problem and drive it forward.
* Have product sense, design taste, and extreme attention to detail

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Embed with our hardware team to find the highest-leverage bottlenecks, and own each one from first idea to a tool engineers rely on every day.
* Build and deploy LLM agents wired into our engineering workflows via tool-calling and MCP.
* Build execution environments where agents can verify their own work, with sandboxed access to simulators, EDA flows, compilers, profilers, and real hardware.
* Ship full-stack internal products from zero to one: the interfaces, data pipelines, and infrastructure that define how Etched builds.
* Measure what works. Design evals and track adoption so we double down on the tools that matter and kill the ones that don’t.
* Take on special projects directly with the founders, surfacing problems across the company and doing whatever it takes to hit critical milestones.

### **Strong candidates may also have**

* Exposure to chip development, kernels, hardware, or manufacturing.
* Infrastructure, data engineering, or DevOps experience
* Fine-tuning, RAG over proprietary technical data, or multi-agent orchestration
* Startup experience, especially through hypergrowth

### **Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage

  + $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits
* Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office
* Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)
* Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

### **Base Compensation Range**

* $150K – $400K+
* Plus Significant Equity

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

### **About Etched**

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Compensation Range: $150K - $400K
